commonPreparation.note: Preformal shared source/prerequisite/evaluator/skill preparation is excluded from formal scores; command-level timestamps retained, no invented split.

formal.note: Per-run total wall/token records include autonomous implementation, prose, tests and fixes. Separate substage costs unknown/null.

independentReview.note: Includes interrupted initial reviewer turns and followups; independent review method corrections retained.

primaryReviewAndDirectedIntervention.note: No reliable per-stage meter; do not estimate. Formal coder first runs received no directed solution feedback.

productionRepair.note: Starts after adjudication seal; own work directories and feedback. Concurrent source/prose phase durations overlap and must not be added as elapsed time.

tokenSemantics: Retain raw token fields. Cached input is contained in input; reasoning output retained as reported, not added to output. Missing fields remain null.
